answer: Each node’s EigenTrust centrality is computed from normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust links, then decayed with an exponential half-life, so reputation persists only through sustained honest service. A new sybil identity has no trusted history and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; it cannot gain consensus influence merely by multiplying identities. A haven of colluding accounts is hollow without credible trust paths, and a bridge to established peers requires reciprocal, reliable behavior over time.
